Peppa is playing at Suzy's house, and they find out that Granny Sheep is moving in. She transforms the dull spare room and attic into an exotic boudoir and creative studio for her to make things.
On a rainy day, Granny Sheep plays in the garden with Peppa and Suzy. They decide to play with cardboard boxes and build a hospital, a cookie factory, and a train station.

Peppa and her friends are at the clubhouse. They are playing at serving takeaway food. The children assign themselves different roles, including a cook and a waiter. Once the imaginary food is ready, they have fun delivering it.
Peppa and George play with walkie-talkies at Granny and Grandpa Pig's house. Grandpa Pig teaches Peppa and George how to use codenames to talk using the gadgets.
Peppa is intrigued to see her parents go to work every day. Daddy Pig makes Peppa her very own office to make her feel good.
Peppa finds a small bird on the ground in the garden of her house. She takes him to Dr Hamster, who explains that it is a swift and is probably tired after a long journey.

Peppa and her family are visiting Cousin Chloe's house to play with Baby Alexander. Peppa thinks she knows all about babies because she already looks after her doll, and George is a baby too, though he disagrees.
Peppa eagerly awaits her new sibling, growing impatient with the lengthy wait. Suddenly, Mummy Pig announces that the baby is coming right now.
Madame Gazelle needs to go to the dentist and Bull takes over Peppa's class. As the children already know the suggested themes, Bull decides to show them how to fix a floorboard that is creaking.
Peppa and George go behind the scenes to find out how TV is made when Miss Rabbit shows them around the set of Super Potato's TV show.
Peppa celebrates Goldie's birthday by holding an undersea party - by turning the house into an underwater environment.

Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the skate park with their bicycles, scooters and skateboards. While Peppa has fun playing around on Daddy's skateboard, she soon learns that he is more of an expert than she realised.
Mr Labrador is here in his new ice cream van. It is his first day selling ice creams. In fact, Mr Labrador loves ice cream, perhaps a little too much.

Granny and Grandpa Pig have been growing strawberries to make jam, but the birds have eaten all the fruit. They decide to go and pick their own at Miss Rabbit's strawberry farm, but Granny and Grandpa eat too many strawberries and end up very full.
Mr Bull builds a brand-new clubhouse and slide for Peppa and her friends.
It's a snowy day and Peppa's family build an igloo for their snowman. They hide in it during a snowstorm, but Penny Polar Bear and her parents love snowstorms and also Peppa's igloo.
The children learn about the weather, there is a new friend for Peppa, and Peppa and George visit Granny and Grandpa's where Grandpa Pig is making a Rock Garden.
Mandy Mouse has a birthday visit to a cheese theme park with Peppa and her friends. Everything in the park is cheese-themed, and Mandy loves cheese.
Inspired by Granny Pig's stories of ancient Rome, Peppa and George decide to design the mosaic of a dinosaur with pebbles, and learn a little Latin.
Peppa and her family have gone on holiday, staying in a teeny tiny little holiday home near the beach. They discover that even when it rains, they can have lots of fun.
Peppa and all her friends are having a sleep-over, with different friends in each of the four different flats in the high street. They decide to play hide and seek across all the rooms.
Grandpa Pig and Grandad Dog are on their boats when Grandpa Pig drops an anchor on his foot! After an x-ray and plaster cast at the hospital, Grandpa Pig needs to stay overnight.

While Mummy Pig is at work, Peppa, George and Daddy make the best out of not being able to use the computer by tidying the kitchen, and when they find a jelly mould, they decide to make a nice surprise for their busy mum.
Grandpa and Granny Pig dust off their motorbike and sidecar to take Peppa and George on a trip. They go to the beach and camp in a tent that folds out of the sidecar.
Peppa Pig and Suzy Sheep are spending the day with Doctor Hamster, and they are learning about what vets do. Doctor Hamster says she's glad to have two helpers with her and calls the next patient.
While at a playgroup with Madame Gazelle, Peppa and her friends learn all about the weather by building themselves a Weather Station, complete with thermometer, wind turbine and rain collector.
Granny Sheep and Suzy take Granny Pig and Peppa around Art House Day; after a day full of screen printing and silhouette miniatures, Granny Pig finds an art piece at Suzy's house.

Mummy and Daddy take Peppa and George for a day out at the botanical gardens. Miss Rabbit is there to greet them and show them around. There's the hot house, the cold house, the rainforest garden and the laboratory where Mr Rabbit creates new varieties of flowers. Last of all, there is the children's garden, which has another water feature... mud!
Peppa and her friends play some very active games in the garden.
Madame Gazelle teaches the children how to play the recorder. They practise a lot at home, then put on a performance for all the parents to enjoy.
Peppa, George and Daddy Pig visit the charity shop to sell things they don't need, and things they may need.
Peppa and George play in their grandparents' garden on a very hot day, but they don't have a paddling pool; Granny and Grandpa Pig create their own water squeezers and even a water slide.
Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig are going out for the evening. Granny and Grandpa Pig babysit Peppa and George. They are too excited to sleep. When Mummy Pig and Daddy Pig get home everyone is asleep.
Peppa and Luzie Locke find that adults have to work all the time. The children imitate the elders, in the shop and on the playground. They realise that playing can be really hard work.
Peppa and her friends learn how to count by playing games at Madame Gazelle's playschool.
Madame Gazelle gives the class a music lesson. There's lots of crashing and banging at first, but it's not long before the grown-ups visit and lay down some notes of their own.
George has fun making bubbles, and Peppa has fun popping them.
Suzy Sheep has come to play with Peppa, and has made up a pretend friend called 'Leo Lion'. Peppa can't see Leo, but Suzy announces that Leo likes roaring and playing dressing up.
It's Daddy Pig's birthday, but he has to go to work, so while he's away, Mummy Pig, Peppa and George prepare a special birthday surprise.
Daddy Pig is left behind when everyone takes Grampy Rabbit's little boat to the riverside picnic spot. Will someone remember him and save him some cake?
When Daddy Pig and Mummy Pig are tidying up the house, they happen to find an old box of musical instruments. George makes a loud sound with the Swiss horn.
Peppa and George love helping Mummy Pig work on her computer, but they like playing computer games more.
Peppa and George are helping Grandpa Pig to dig a new pond for his garden. While digging, they find hidden treasure so they go to see Mr Richard in the museum.
Dr Hamster's pet tortoise, Tiddles, once again gets stuck on top of a tree, but everyone in the rescue team finds it tough to get the tortoise down.
Peppa and her family are at the swimming pool. George is a little worried at first but is soon splashing happily with his friend Richard Rabbit.
Peppa and George are helping Granny and Grandpa Pig tidy their attic, but they have trouble deciding what to throw out because Granny and Grandpa want to keep everything.

It's a beautiful day but Peppa, George and Grandpa Pig are sitting inside watching the motor racing on the television. Granny Pig shoos them all outside to enjoy the sunshine. Inspired by the racing, Grandpa Pig builds George his own racing car.
Naughty Daisy and Poppy magic their teacher, Mrs Fotheringill, to the centre of the Earth, so Granpapa Thistle leads Ben and Holly on a rescue mission.
Nanny Plum takes the Fairy children for a nature class in the woods and bumps into the Wise Old Elf who is teaching a nature class to the Elf children.
Miss Cookie's class is out on a nature trail, in the Little Kingdom! It is up to Ben and Holly to prevent the elves and fairies being discovered.
Everyone in Peppa's town is excited to meet Mr Potato when he comes to open a new sports centre.
At Peppa's playgroup, Madame Gazelle wants everyone to show the class their special talent.
Mrs Zebra teaches Peppa, George, Zoe, Zaza and Zuzu Zebra how to make a real tea set from clay.
Peppa's playgroup is holding a jumble sale to raise money for a new roof and Madame Gazelle asks everyone to bring something to sell. Peppa and each of her friends bring in an old toy.
Oh dear, Miss Rabbit's train has broken down and all her passengers need to get to work. So Grandpa Pig lends Miss Rabbit his little train, Gertrude.

Everyone is down at the lake as it's a perfect day to go boating. Miss Rabbit has all sorts of boats for hire and Daddy Pig picks one with pedals, but when all the families have a race, he soon wishes he had picked something easier to sail.
Blue's old friends Steve and Joe help Josh and the audience solve their first game of `Blue's Clues.'

Mr Gruber does a good turn for Paddington and says he can thank him by passing it on to someone else, which is harder than it sounds; Paddington learns all about composting thanks to Mr Mulch, and is hoping to grow flowers.
Ben, Holly, and their friends go on a snail trek. Everything goes well until the snails start to head to Mr Elf's cabbages.
The elves give the King some chickens from the Elf Farm so that he can have eggs whenever he likes.
Snobby King and Queen Marigold are coming to visit the Little Kingdom, and Holly and her Mummy and Daddy enlist the Elf Band to impress them.
The children have adopted a new pet, a dragon named Dave. They did not know that he was going to grow and grow though and need to find him a place where he belongs.
It's bedtime, but Peppa is not sleepy, so Daddy Pig tells Peppa and George a story about a pretty princess and a dinosaur.
Daddy Pig hangs his clean football shirt out to dry, but Peppa, George and Mummy splash it with mud. They put it in the wash, but Peppa puts her red dress in too, which turns Daddy's shirt pink.
Suzy and Peppa start a Secret Club where they go on secret missions, and do secret things, but soon everyone wants to join.
Rebecca Rabbit has a little brother called Richard who is the same age as George. George and Richard each have a toy dinosaur, but the boys are not very good at sharing their toys.
When a power cut plunges their house into darkness, Peppa and George have fun looking for a torch and thinking of games to play in the dark.

Mummy Pig is determined that George's new hat doesn't get muddy when Peppa and George visit Grandpa and Granny Pig. Everyone tries to make sure that it stays clean, even if it means that they get messy instead.
Peppa and the Pig family attend a school fête. Peppa's favourite things at the fête are face painting, the balloons, and the bouncy castle.

Blue's friend Magenta is coming over today. We play Blue's Clues to figure out what Blue wants to do with Magenta. During our search for clues, we identify opposites and check out animal footprint with our friends Shovel and Pail.
Paddington's excited about the grand opening of the city farm, but the animals escape when the gate is left open. Baaz teaches Jonathan and Paddington a lesson about the value of upcycling.
Holly accidentally turns Ben into a frog. With the help of her friends, Holly tries to turn Ben back into an elf but instead turns him into a bird and then a rabbit.
Ben and Holly set out in the elves' new vessel to try and rescue Redbeard the elf pirate's sunken treasure. However, hungry Big Bad Barry is determined to stop them.
A magical card arrives in the Little Kingdom, inviting everyone to a party at Granny and Granpapa Thistle's castle in the clouds.
Holly forgets Ben's birthday and rushes home to make him a birthday card, but Nanny has stopped all magic, so Holly has to make the card herself.

Daddy Pig loves to watch television, but Peppa Pig thinks that he needs to do some exercise. She says that Daddy Pig's tummy is looking a bit big. Daddy Pig disagrees but says that Peppa can be in charge of getting him fit. Peppa gives him lots of exercises to do, and Daddy Pig is exhausted by the end of the day.
Peppa and George visit Granny Pig, who is very excited about her new pet, a parrot called Polly.
Mummy Pig, Daddy Pig, Peppa and George go to the supermarket, and George sits in the trolley while Peppa finds the things on Mummy's shopping list.

George eats his breakfast too quickly and gets hiccups, so Peppa tries to help him get rid of them. After trying everything else, there is only one solution left for Peppa to cure him with - to scare him!
Peppa's friends are all riding their bicycles. Peppa is determined to learn to cycle without her stabilisers after she teases George about having a baby's tricycle.
Peppa loves secrets, so Mummy Pig makes her a special box to put secret things in.
Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy enjoy flying a kite in the park until their kite gets tangled in a tree beside a big, muddy puddle.
Paddington wants to make a special cake. Paddington and Mateo form a table tennis team.
When the fairies wake up to find that their wands are not working, the kingdom has to cope without any help from magic for the entire day.
Holly invites Ben to the annual Royal Fairy Picnic. King Thistle hopes there won't be a repeat of last year's magical jelly flood.
Snooty King and Queen Marigold invite themselves round for dinner to King and Queen Thistle's Castle to sample Nanny Plum's cooking. Nanny tries very hard to cook special modern food.
The bath tap at the Little Castle is dripping, so the elf plumber is called. It's a bigger job than first expected, but with King and Queen Marigolds coming round, there's not much time.
Gabby gets a wishing fountain and helps make the kitties' wishes come true, but Pandy can't decide what he wants - until CatRat gets into a pickle!

After Peppa's tooth falls out, Mummy Pig explains that the Tooth Fairy will come that very night to take the tooth and leave a shiny coin in its place. Peppa plans to stay awake all night to see the Tooth Fairy.
Peppa and George wake up one morning to find that all the rain has made a flood, and their house is now a desert island.
Peppa and George are playing in Grandpa Pig's garden when they find a little snail.
There's a spider in the house. Mummy Pig tells Daddy Pig to get rid of it. Mr Skinny-Legs is set free in the garden, where he can spin all the webs he likes.

Peppa and George's toy basket is full, and their beds are covered in toys, so Mummy Pig decides it is time to order a new toy cupboard. The cupboard arrives in the post, but it needs to be assembled - and Mummy and Daddy Pig are not very good at DIY. Luckily help is at hand, as Mr Zebra the Postman loves assembling flat-pack furniture.
It's fruit day at the market and Miss Rabbit is making smoothies from people's favourite fruit. She gives George a special 'dinosaur' juice to make him big and strong.
Peppa and George want to jump in muddy puddles, but Mummy tells them to go in the pool instead.
Delphine the donkey comes to stay. Peppa takes Delphine to playgroup, where they teach her the 'Bing Bong Song'.
Grandpa Pig needs help when his boat sinks, so Granddad Dog gives them all a lift to Grampy Rabbit's Boatyard so that the boat can be fixed.
Peppa and her family spend Christmas in Australia, on the beach with Kylie Kangaroo. Kylie has never seen snow, but she is given a special Christmas present: a snow globe.
Peppa and George wake up in Granny and Grandpa's motorbike tent by the sea. Peppa finds a message in a bottle with a telephone number on it.
Police Officer Panda and Police Officer Squirrel visit Peppa's playgroup. They offer two lucky children the chance to spend the day with them.
Speed Meister's rollercoaster sends a pet play date out of control in 'Pups Save the Teetering Tower', then in 'Pups Save the Spelunkers', will Motor go boom and cost the Crew a gold star?
Boomer decides to challenge Roxy to a race. When Boomer's monster truck stunt goes wrong, he gets left dangling from a drawbridge while his monster truck goes on without a driver.

When a fishing trip goes wrong, leaving Grandpa Pig and Grampy Rabbit stranded on a desert island, Captain Daddy Dog is the only one able to save them. It makes him realise that he misses the sea after all.
Grandpa Pig hides some pirate treasure in his garden, and when Peppa and George come, they have to look for it, using a map and following the clues.
Mummy Pig gives her old computer to Granny and Grandpa Pig. They use it for lots of important work, as well as Happy Mrs Chicken, but when it breaks they are not sure who will fix it.
Doctor Hamster is rushed off her feet when nearly all the animals need her help on the same day.
Madame Gazelle takes Peppa and her school friends on a school bus trip to the mountains. From the top of the mountains, there is a fantastic view, and Peppa and her friends have fun hearing echoes.

It is school project time for Peppa and her friends, which means they have to build castles and bring them into playgroup. Mummy and Daddy Pig have lots of fun helping Peppa make hers, if only they could find the glitter.

Peppa, George, Mummy and Daddy Pig have gone to visit Madame Gazelle. The family soon realise that her house is being pushed over by the tall tree next to it. Mr. Bull arrives and with his help they all manage to save Madame Gazelle's House and tree.
Blaze, AJ, Crusher and Pickle decide to go on a daring quest in order to find the pieces of the Broken Key and unlock a secret treasure.
Missy, eine Freundin aus Carlys Kindheit, taucht auf und versucht, Sam zu verdrängen und sabotiert Sam, wo sie nur kann. Ob Missy wohl auffliegen wird?
Carly bittet Spencer um Kunstunterricht. Doch er übertreibt maßlos und sie verliert die Lust. Sam und Freddie machen bei einem Wettbewerb mit, um den begehrten Spind 239 zu ergattern.

Carly, Sam und Freddie wollen zehn Preise für die beste Nutzergestaltung verleihen und bitten Spencer, die Trophäen zu basteln. Leider fertigt er aber nur eine Statue an, die dafür riesig ist. Er muss sich auf die Schnelle etwas einfallen lassen.

Freddie versucht zu beweisen, dass Sams Zwillingsschwester Melanie in Wirklichkeit nur die verkleidete Sam ist. Währenddessen gibt Carly Chuck Nachhilfe. Spencer versucht sie zu überzeugen, dass Chuck schlechte Absichten hat.
Showsegmente von iCarly tauchen in der Show "Totally Teri" im Fernsehen auf. Die Autoren haben die Ideen geklaut und die Kinder wollen nach Hollywood und die Autoren zur Rede stellen.

Sam muss zum Zahnarzt, da sie einen Zahn verloren hat. Sie wird unter Lachgas behandelt und erzählt Carly, dass sie und Freddie sich geküsst haben. Carly ist verletzt und stellt Freddie zur Rede. Sam will nie wieder Geheimnisse vor Carly haben.

Sam, Carly und Freddie sind Fans des Starkochs Ricky Flame. Sie wollen eine Kochsparte machen und als erstes Rezept Spaghetti Tacos machen. Ricky Flame fordert sie zum Kochduell auf, wobei das iCarly-Team gewinnt.

Rektor Franklin gratuliert seiner Tochter live bei der Webshow zum Geburtstag. Kurz darauf wird er aber deswegen von Superintendent Goreman gefeuert. Statt ihm werden Miss Briggs und Mister Howard eingesetzt und die Schüler müssen handeln.

Die Mädchen sollen auf einer Party einen Begleiter wählen. Carly passiert ein Missgeschick und spuckt dem Auserwählten versehentlich ins Auge. Er lehnt sie ab und nun ist es an Sam, einen Partner für Carly zu finden.

Es ist Halloween und SpongeBob hat Angst vor jedem, der ihm über den Weg läuft, nur sein eigenes Kostüm findet niemand gruselig. Patrick hilft ihm, das zu ändern, derweil passt Thaddäus unfreiwillig auf Gary auf, und kümmert sich nicht gut um ihn.
Thaddäus macht versehentlich eine Zeitreise, bei der er immer wieder SpongeBob und Patrick in verschiedenen Zeiten trifft. Sandy und SpongeBob bekommen derweil von Mr. Krabs Karate-Verbot erteilt.

SpongeBob und Patrick werden vom Geist des fliegenden Holländers in Geister verwandelt und sind darüber nicht glücklich. Thaddäus und SpongeBob sollen sich in der Arbeit einen Spind teilen, doch SpongeBob verwandelt ihn in ein Lager.

Es ist Halloween, und SpongeBob hat ein Problem. Er gruselt sich vor allem und jedem, aber ihn will niemand gruselig finden. Mithilfe von Patrick macht er sich ein 'gruseliges' Kostüm zurecht, das unter anderem auch einen radikalen Haar- oder vielmehr Schwammschnitt mit sich bringt. Aber auch damit bleiben die Erfolge bescheiden. Da taucht auf der Halloween-Party in der Krossen Krabbe plötzlich der echte Fliegende Holländer auf, dem seine schlechten Kopisten auf die Nerven gehen.

Plankton will die Quallenfelder und die Krosse Krabbe abreißen lassen, um dort eine große Straße bauen zu lassen. SpongeBob kämpft dagegen an, schafft es allerdings nicht. Doch dann bekommt er Unterstützung aus der Natur.

SpongeBob und Patrick machen versehentlich eine Zeitreise mit der Zeitmaschine von Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube. SpongeBob findet derweil eine Videokassette, auf der die verschollene Folge von Meerjungfraumann und Blaubarschbube ist.

SpongeBob ist dafür bekannt, dass er viel und oft weint. Er schließt mit Thaddäus eine Wette ab, dass er es schaffen könnte, einen Tag nicht zu weinen. SpongeBob muss währenddessen einen Neuen in der Krossen Krabbe einarbeiten.

Plankton hat es wieder einmal auf Mr. Krabs und SpongeBob abgesehen, doch Perla entdeckt, dass Plankton Angst vor Walen hat und rettet die beiden. Gary verliebt sich im Schneckenpark in Mary, doch diese hat einen zornigen Freund.

Thaddäus will in der Krossen Krabbe sein Theaterstück aufführen, muss dabei aber weiterarbeiten. SpongeBob macht sich währenddessen Sorgen um Sandy, die in Texas ihren Rodeo-Meistertitel verteidigt und startet eine Rettungsaktion.

Patrick bekommt ein paar neue Schuhe. SpongeBob bietet an, seine Schnürsenkel zu binden, vergisst aber, wie es geht. Mr. Krabs nimmt sich einen Tag frei von der Krossen Krabbe. Squidward nutzt die Gelegenheit, um sich auch einen Tag freizunehmen.
Dora und Boots werden zu Meerjungfrauen und helfen Marisol dabei, ihr Zuhause zu retten. Dora und Boots helfen ihrem Delfin-Freund bei der Suche nach dem besten Geschenk, dem magischen Juwel.

Tim, Tommy, Tia und Papa sitzen auf einem Asteroiden fest. Darüber hinaus müssen Tim und seine Freunde einen Ball aus Mamas Schlafzimmer holen. Außerdem hängt Tias Ballon in einem Baum fest, woraufhin er ihn befreien will.

Als Bürgermeister Humdinger erneut kandidiert, gerät sein Fahrzeug außer Kontrolle. Die Paw Patrol eilt zur Rettung. Als Ryder und die Welpen Tracker und Carlos im Dschungel besuchen, gerät eine Gruppe Affen in eine heikle Lage.

Mr. Porter und Alex gehen zusammen auf eine Wanderung, um die Umgebung zu erkunden, doch dabei bleiben sie in einem Labyrinth stecken. Travis landet in der Antarktis, wo er fälschlicherweise glaubt, er befinde sich auf dem Mars.
Für einen Wettbewerb soll Lincoln den Energieverbrauch reduzieren, aber das ist nicht so einfach.

Lola und Lana müssen einige Prüfungen bestehen, um bei den Bluebells aufgenommen zu werden. Loris Freund Bobby trifft sich mit anderen Mädchen. Lincoln und Clyde verfolgen ihn, um herauszufinden, was er vorhat, und ihn zu überführen.
Ein klassischer Bösewicht kehrt in sein altes Versteck zurück und trifft auf die Familie Estrella.

Franz Roll hält Schere für einen Hund, adoptiert ihn und macht Stein eifersüchtig. Papier fürchtet das jährliche Familientreffen, da seine Familie extrem erfolgreich ist. Um sich nicht zu blamieren, plant Papier, sich selbst entführen zu lassen.

Schere, Stein und Papier versuchen, ihre Tradition aufrechtzuerhalten, jeden Moonami-Film am Premierentag zu sehen. Das Trio landet vor einem Spinnenrichter und einer Jury, weil es versucht hat, eine Spinne in seiner Wohnung zu zerquetschen.

Die Krusty Krab ist komplett verdreckt und es ist SpongeBobs Aufgabe, sie wieder auf Vordermann zu bringen. Glücklicherweise erscheint ihm ein magischer Fisch, der ihm beibringt, das gesamte Restaurant blitzblank zu putzen.

Als Lady Hochnas die Schirmherrin von Thaddäus wird, beschließt sie, dessen Musiktalente vor ihren Freunden vorzustellen. Außerdem will Thaddäus beweisen, dass es keine Außerirdischen gibt, bis er selbst plötzlich einem begegnet.
SpongeBob und Patrick versuchen, Thaddäus für sein Vorspielen zu wecken, doch sie scheitern. Mr. Krabs wird für ein nobles Catering gebucht. Die Kundschaft scheint jedoch eine Nummer zu groß zu sein.

Plankton vergisst seinen Hochzeitstag, obwohl Karen das ideale Geschenk für ihn parat hatte. Sie hatte die Krabbenburger-Geheimformel herausgefunden. Sie ist schwer enttäuscht von seiner Ignoranz und will sie ihm deshalb nicht geben.

Der Familienpapagei Sergio wird von einer Gruppe von Vögeln verwöhnt, die denkt, er sei ihre Mutter. Ronnie Anne Santiago und Sid Chang helfen Casey dabei, seinen Familien-Imbisswagen beim Yoon-Kwan-Konzert zu betreiben.

Bobbys Traum, in einer Band zu spielen, könnte endlich wahr werden, aber dafür muss er mit Pars Punkerfreunden zurechtkommen. Sameer fürchtet, mit seinen coolen Freunden nicht mithalten zu können, und geht auf Rekordjagd.

Das Team von Action News findet heraus, wie Kathrine Mulligan ihre Nachrichten findet. Außerdem bastelt sich Lisa eine neue Brille, da sie nicht zum Augenarzt gehen möchte. Doch es stellt sich heraus, dass diese die Sehkraft sogar verschlechtert.

Nachdem es den Kindern nicht gelungen ist, für den Chefkoch Guy Grazer in seiner Sendung ein Essen zuzubereiten, versuchen sie, die Bilder zu löschen, bevor sie ausgestrahlt werden. Zudem suchen sie in ganz Royal Woods nach den fehlenden Möbeln.

Lily benutzt zum Entsetzen ihrer Geschwister andauernd ein Schimpfwort, das sie zufällig gehört hat. Ein Brief, adressiert an "L. Loud", erreicht die Familie. Doch keiner weiß, für wen der Liebesbrief bestimmt ist und wer der geheime Verehrer ist.
SpongeBob und Mr. Krabs wollen gefrorene Krabbenburger verkaufen und lassen sich von einem Werbefachmann dazu beraten.

In der Krossen Krabbe tauchen immer wieder anonyme Mitteilungen am Anschlagbrett auf, die unter den Angestellten für Unmut sorgen. Diese Nachrichten führen zu Verwirrung und Misstrauen unter den Mitarbeiter:innen. Die harmonische Arbeitsatmosphäre wird dadurch erheblich gestört.
Um zu einer Food-Messe zu kommen, muss die Krosse Crew sich in der Wildnis durchschlagen. SpongeBob muss den Schein wahren, als ihn ein Brieffreund besucht, den er vorher angeschwindelt hat.

Schere versucht, als Hausmeister zu arbeiten, merkt jedoch, dass in dem Job mehr zu tun ist. Dafür braucht er mehr Geschick, als er zuerst erwartet hat. Doch Stein und Papier wollen Schere in der Jobsuche aushelfen.

Patrick und SpongeBob arbeiten unentgeltlich im Kino, damit sie einen neuen Film sehen können. Das läuft nicht ganz nach Plan. Sandy versucht zu verhindern, dass Patrick in seiner Wissenschaftssendung unwissenschaftliche Dinge preisgibt.
Die Starfamilie ist im Badezimmer eingesperrt; Bunny und Cecil haben eine standesamtliche Hochzeit.

Stella hütet das Haus der Direktorin und lädt ihre Freunde heimlich zu einer Poolparty ein. Doch das Unterfangen ist riskant. Gleichzeitig entbrennt zwischen Luna und Luan ein harter Konkurrenzkampf um ein Künstler-Stipendium.
Im Camp Mastodon müssen Lincoln und Clyde gegen die härtesten Jungs im Kampf antreten.

Im Camp Mastodon bringt Lynn die übervorsichtige Lisa dazu, endlich ihre abenteuerlichere Seite zu entdecken. Als Lori erfährt, dass ihre Mitcamper im Camp Mastodon sie uncool finden, beschließt sie, die Regeln zu brechen.

Als SpongeBob und Patrick sich Nachrichten per Muscheln schicken, gerät Thaddäus ins Chaos. SpongeBob glaubt, eine neue Allergie zu entwickeln, nachdem er bereits seinen millionsten Krabbenburger auf der Arbeit zubereitet.

Als der Zirkus in die Stadt kommt und seine Kunden stiehlt, versucht Mr. Krabs, die Show zu sabotieren. / Sandy verbringt den Tag damit, die Probleme aller zu lösen, kehrt dann aber nach Hause zurück und hat plötzlich eigene Probleme.
Plankton nimmt Selbstverteidigungsstunden von Sandy; Mr. Krabs geht ins Fitnessstudio.

Plankton nutzt Patricks Naivität aus, indem er ihm weismacht, gewissenlos zu sein. Er tut dies, um Patrick dazu zu bringen, einen Krabbenburger für ihn zu stehlen. Dieser Plan spiegelt Planktons ständige Versuche wider, an das Geheimrezept der Krabbenburger zu gelangen.

Ellie and the kids investigate cryptic Mrs. Withers, but when Jack goes missing in her creepy home, Ellie and Lil must save him; eager to become master criminals, Lil and Jack help Chuck with his dirty laundry, but are they ready for a life of crime?

Lil intros Jack to a deserted theme park: Lake Island; when they're stranded, their new friendship quickly crumbles; Will tries to connect with Jack at the oddball store Mike A's; everything goes awry and they must fight.

On Christmas Eve, SpongeBob and his friends look back on some of the fun and less-than-jolly Christmas moments; when Christmas morning comes around, they realise that what matters is the warmth of holiday cheer.

Alvin sneaks into Simon's lab to look at his latest invention, only to accidentally clone himself. With two Alvins, there's double the trouble. Alvin tells a small lie that quickly turns into a huge disaster, dragging everyone into his tangled web.

As Sarah and Gideon's crushes on Max and Phoebe escalate, the twins set them up on a date with each other to solve the problem once and for all. However, when Max discovers Sarah's uncle is a rock star, he wants to win her back.

Nana and Pop Pop Thunderman visit, but after Phoebe accidentally reveals that Colosso is living in their house with Max, Pop Pop's no-tolerance attitude toward super-villains leads him to banish Max and his bunny best friend to the Detention Zone.

Ray agrees to let Henry fly his helicopter, but it's too much for Ray when he starts to act like a nervous parent. Charlotte, Jasper, and Piper find a candy floss machine in Junk-N-Stuff and start making candy floss.
After discovering contestants on Swellview's Got Talent are losing consciousness, Captain Man and Kid Danger enlist the help of Charlotte and Schwoz in order to find out what is causing the mischief.
The whole city is hunting critters on their phones. The Marsups even play on Gran Gran's phone. Mica believes that Marcel is interested in astronomy so befriends him!
Hope's in a runaway bouncy ball. A statue is broken, but by whom?
Dwayne is turned into a tracker dog to help his uncle to catch the Smurfs.
Gargamel bewitches Meteorite's drum and hypnotises the Smurfies.

Annoyed that Azrael does not like his baking, Chef makes some delicious cat food for him that makes him gentle. Gargamel sees an opportunity to make his mother kinder. Dwayne loves Lily's waffles and keeps wanting more.

Stuck at home during a storm, Simon invents a virtual reality game that quickly spirals out of control. Cheesy convinces Theodore and Alvin to help him steal the canteen's desserts through a secret network of underground tunnels.

Alvin invites Dave's old high school rival to an elaborate dinner to prove to him that Dave is a huge success. The Chipmunks can't wait to go on a World tour until Theodore and Alvin realise what they'll be leaving behind.
To increase baby love, Baby Boss schemes to change the local soccer team's name from the Hive to the Babies.
After sneaking into a grown-up movie, Tim decides he's ready for the adult world; Boss Baby sleeps over at a friend's house.

When Scissors lies about Rock's birthday to get free cake, the trio must go on the run; when Paper lies to impress his neighbour, Pencil, he winds up having to defend the world from an alien invasion.
Squidina has to direct her school holiday play, but her script was mangled by Patrick.
SpongeBob Squarepants chronicles the adventures of a rectangular, yellow sponge that lives under the sea beneath the tropical isle of Bikini Atoll, in the sub-surface city of Bikini Bottom.
When one of Sandy's experiments goes awry, the Cheeks family team up to save Christmas in Bikini Bottom.
The constantly-crying 'worst baby in the world' is making life miserable for all of his neighbours, and Boss Baby's field team hopes to turn things around.
Competition for cuteness heats up when a stray kitten appears on the Templetons' doorstep and the family decides to take him in.
The Stars party at the Chum Bucket; Patrick hosts his show after dark, exploring what Bikini Bottom is like at night.
Pat The Hapless goes on a barbaric quest to the shopping mall; after Captain Quasar replaces Pat-Tron with a more efficient robot, Pat-Tron works for the Star family.
When Plankton takes over the North Pole, SpongeBob, Mr Krabs and a group of misfits team up to save Christmas.

Paper and Pencil tell a kind of funny joke at a party and chase the feeling of people finding them funny by telling it again and again. Scissors hires an orchestra to follow him around and score his life.

Rock, Paper, and Scissors' old friend Shoot comes back to town, ready for more of his favourite activity, exhaustingly annoying competitions. Rock starts his job as Franz Roll's assistant and learns just how demanding his role model is.
SpongeBob helps Patrick fulfil his bucket list, Patrick devolves back into a baby.
Bunny sends Squidina to camp, so Patrick works with new staff in. The Star family enjoys a cruise ship holiday in outer space.
Mr Krabs and Plankton must cooperate after being shipwrecked on a desert island. SpongeBob and Squidina attempt to start a rival Captain Quasar fan club after Bubble Bass kicks them out.
SpongeBob falls asleep on the bus and ends up in a town full of Bikini Bottom doppelgängers; after Squidward loses his memory, he adopts a new tough guy persona.

Scissors meets his perfect romantic match, but she's a mermaid and he can't tell anyone about her. Rock accidentally shrinks Franz and himself while Paper and Scissors host a party to apologise to everyone they've wronged.
SpongeBob and his pals journey to the North Pole to give Santa a present.
Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment
Max pretends to turn evil to infiltrate Mastermind's henchmen and steal the Chip-Chucker, a device that previously turned him evil.
After Jasper is lauded for being a local hero, Henry becomes jealous that Kid Danger is the one getting thanks while Henry himself gets nothing.
When Captain Man gets arrested for committing a petty crime, he is forced to spend Christmas in jail. Henry and Charlotte must try to help Captain Man have a good Christmas in jail.

Lincoln is excited to stay up late with his best friend Clyde to watch the RIP Hardcore Midnight Marathon, but his plans are ruined when his dad institutes an early curfew; they come up with the idea to celebrate his half-birthday.

When Lincoln tries to get out of his chores on chore day, he and Clyde end up on a police ride-along, drawing unwanted attention from the notorious Custard Gang leader; Dad loses all the other kids throughout the afternoon.
Phoebe fakes a romance after feeling left out with her friends all in relationships, but maintaining the lie proves to be harder than she expected.
Phoebe and Max must work together on a series of superhero team-building exercises, but their different approaches to training jeopardise their future as a crime-fighting duo.
When Piper gets a mysterious illness, Captain Man must travel back in time to the 1700s to find the only cure.
Henry gets a series of mysterious notes from someone and worries that this person may know his secret identity.
The team suits up to stop Mega Fat CEO Baby from winning an office spirit day contest that is totally rigged.
A "free" family holiday comes at a cost when Tim is tasked with keeping a plane full of babies calm on an eight-hour flight to Paris.

Paper and Sandpaper are on a train that gets hijacked by The Algebra Villain, who will make them crash unless Paper solves an algebra problem. Rock and Scissors think of the perfect prank call, but Rock bails to watch Franz Roll's pet, Kitty.
While Tim works overtime to do good in the neighbourhood, Staci and Boss Baby go undercover to rescue Jimbo from a house that's crawling with cats.

Paper and Pencil inadvertently create a horde of Rock clones and decide to look after them together. Rock, Paper, and Scissors find a genie, but just as they're about to make their wish, his 1,000-year curse runs out, and he can no longer grant it.
Plankton has a new invention that allows him to switch lives with Mr Krabs. When Larry the Lobster is short one man for lifeguard duty, SpongeBob volunteers.
SpongeBob house-sits for Mermaid Man and Barnacle Boy. SpongeBob is a comedy sensation when he tells mean jokes.
Patrick goes overboard when he takes SpongeBob on as a role model. SpongeBob blows a bubble to keep him company when Patrick goes out of town.
Patrick comes to boating school with SpongeBob and soon gets on his nerves. Mr. Krabs takes SpongeBob and Squidward clam fishing.

After arriving one minute late for work, SpongeBob decides to move into the Krusty Krab so that he will never be late again. When Plankton secretly turns down the thermostat at the Krusty Krab, the entire restaurant freezes over.

Mr Krabs' granddad is coming to town. However, Mr Krabs is nervous because his swarthy pirate granddad thinks that Mr Krabs is a pirate, too. Squidward is a member of a secret society and SpongeBob decides he wants to join.
SpongeBob and Patrick play hide and seek and SpongeBob searches the world for Patrick. Plankton masquerades as Gary to steal the Krabby Patty formula.

When Nobby becomes too civilised for Narlene, SpongeBob and Patrick help him remember his backwoods ways. Perch and his pal, Harvey, report the news of Kamp Koral, but they stumble upon evidence of a ridiculous conspiracy.
A young SpongeBob is determined to catch his first jellyfish, so his friends do whatever they can to help him.
The Roxie sisters go their separate ways; The Dinghy cabin kids discover life after dark.
SpongeBob and Patrick go on an advertising blitz. Mr. Krabs and Plankton issue petitions to get their rival's restaurant bulldozed.
SpongeBob learns that imitation is the sincerest form of flattery. When worms move in to SpongeBob's holes, he has to hide his disgusting new friends from everyone else.
Sandy takes her Science Scout troop on a trip to the moon. In space, no one can hear you 'NYAH-NYAH-NYAH-NYAH'.
Animated, Children, Holiday, Comedy, Fantasy, Entertainment
Narlene and Nobby teach Regigille all about backwoods living; the Trawler cabin creates the perfect camper to compete in the Camp Summer Games.
It's the annual foam-fisted all-camp karate battle, and SpongeBob trains to beat the butt-kicking Sandy. It's the hottest day of summer, but there's only one AC in the whole camp.
When SpongeBob thinks he's allergic to his pineapple, Squidward offers to help find him a new home. Squidward is getting a nose job at the local hospital, and SpongeBob tags along as moral support.
SpongeBob volunteers to babysit, then SpongeBob and Patrick volunteer as guards at the museum, while Squidward attempts to hang his painting unnoticed.
The campers meet two backwoods narwhals named Narlene and Nobby, who treat them to a sweet surprise.
Theodore's new talking teddy bear drives Alvin and Simon crazy. Alvin is not thrilled about going back to school, until he sees the new principal.
After a fight with Brittany, Eleanor decides to move in with Alvin and his brothers. Theodore posts a video of himself rapping on the Internet and it becomes a big hit.
Plankton teams up with Man Ray to take over the Krusty Krab and then, the world. Squidward quits the Krusty Krab to work for Plankton, turning the Chum Bucket into an overnight success.
Plankton disguises himself as SpongeBob's grandmother. Mr Krabs uses SpongeBob's pet Gary to find spare change.
It's standup comedy night at Kamp Koral, and the campers are ready to laugh until they scream. Patrick gets confused with a young Seasquatch while out in the woods.

Santa Claus visits the children of Kamp Koral, who aren't quite sure what to make of the jolly giant; the outhouse explodes in front of Mr. Krabs, but he gets three different sides of the story from his campers.
Alvin believes a neighbour is responsible for a recent diamond heist. Alvin tries to get out of the annual family day picnic with Dave to go to a big soccer game.
Dave gets a parenting app to help supervise the Chipmunks. Alvin, Simon and the Chipettes give Theodore conflicting dating advice when they believe he has a crush on a girl.

A friendly day of building sand castles soon turns into all out war when SpongeBob and Patrick use their sand creations to battle each other. Gary desperately needs a new shell, but all the shells on the market are either too expensive or too fragile.
SpongeBob and Mr Krabs turn an old submarine into a mobile Krusty Krab. When Patrick and SpongeBob discover they have clashing views on cleanliness, their disagreement blows up into an epic battle.
Craig Mammalton learns what it's like to not be the best at something; Patrick and a cake hide out in the wilderness.
Plankton discovers competition in Narlene's backwoods restaurant; Sandy spends a night at the Trawler cabin.
Alvin catches Simon taking a test to discover his soul mate. Simon and Alvin decide to rebel and launch their own campaigns for class president.
Simon is ecstatic when he is elected as the school's safety monitor. Dave brings the Chipmunks on a technology-free camping trip.
It's King Neptune's birthday, and SpongeBob wants to make sure his friends and family are there, including his son, Triton, but Neptune and Triton don't get along.

Everyone is in awe of Larry the Lobster's daredevil ways, especially SpongeBob and Patrick. Everybody who's anybody is going to a big party in Bikini Bottom, but you have to be a certain shade of tan to get in.
Krabs reignites his passion for clowning. Mo learns a new kind of fun and camaraderie.
SpongeBob and Patrick compete to be camp mascot. Krabs and Squidward play the most dangerous game.
Jeanette seeks Alvin's advice when she wants to give a toast to Brittany at her upcoming party. Alvin decides to borrow Brittany's babysitting job.
Dave worries that the Chipmunks have become addicted to a video game. A grounded Alvin begs Theodore to buy him a limited edition skateboard.

Mr Krabs gets trapped in Bikini Bottom's brand-new bank, and it's up to SpongeBob and Patrick to save him. After failing again to steal the Krabby Patty formula, Plankton gets a pet to cheer himself up.
Plankton's giant Chum Bucket glove runs wild in town, but SpongeBob has a handy friend to help them out. SpongeBob takes his first break ever at work.
After SpongeBob and Patrick eat an experiment, Plankton must counteract the monstrous side effects. Elsewhere, Mr Crab must find a babysitter for Pearl, but she proves to be demanding to care for.

When an unsatisfied anchovy strays from his brothers, SpongeBob and Patrick must help him find his true identity. SpongeBob is sent to time-out on behalf of his buddy, so Patrick does what he can to rectify the situation.
Alvin believes his mojo was in a cap he regrets giving to a fan. During a visit to the zoo, Alvin is mistaken for a Tasmanian devil.
The Chipmunks decide to find Dave a new girlfriend. The Chipmunks accidentally ruin Dave's new song for a music festival.
With the Krusty Krab's new open 24 hours policy, the employees must work around the clock. Mr Krabs loses his shell right before a big reunion with his old buddies.

When Plankton slips and falls on some water at the Krusty Krab, he sues Mr Krabs for failing to post a wet floor sign. If Plankton wins the case, he will be awarded everything that Mr Krabs owns, including the secret recipe formula.
After SpongeBob, Patrick and Sandy are banned from playing pirate outside, they decide to turn their cabin into a pirate ship. SpongeBob pretends to be a jellyfish for research purposes.
Counsellor Squidward is determined for his cabin to win the annual camp art competition. The Kamp Koral campers befriend a cute cow with a big appetite.
It is the day of the grand re-opening of 'Blow 'n' Go', the Solana's hair and beauty salon, and Kenneth has hired a huge inflatable for the occasion.
Arthur and Terry are ensnared in international intrigue when they deal with a Russian ship and its crew.
Tracey becomes self-conscious about her appearance and has Botox, Travis has a tattoo to impress a girl at school and Sharon looks as if she'll need a hearing aid.
Gary bumps into his former talent agent, Sidney Wix, which leads to an unwelcome collaboration with superstar ukulele player, George Formby.
George sells Mildred's sun lamp to Larry, who then sells it on to Robin, who wants a pre-holiday tan. Mildred spots Robin's tan and accuses him of stealing from her.
Host Kenny Everett welcomes Thin Lizzy and Levinsky Sinclair for music and laughter.
The best music from the 1960s and some forgotten gems. The soundtrack to New Year's Day.
News, interviews and features for Scotland from the last week.

It's summer of 1925 and Richard Bellamy is anxious to be appointed to the post of Under Secretary of State for Foreign Affairs. He thinks that the influential millionaire Sir Guy Paynter may be able to help him, so he asks Virginia to invite him to lunch, much to her dismay. However, when the tabloids link Virginia and Guy romantically, Richard is forced to ask that Virginia stop seeing him.
Bernard tries to get his students to care more for the elderly in their community, but the class is less than a little enthusiastic.
With Amy having sent all his clothes to the cleaners, David looks doomed to spend the rest of his holiday in drag. He gets no sympathy from his wife or the Cochrans.
As an aid to married conductresses with small children, the bus company opens a crèche, run by a formidable elderly nurse. Stan suggests that Olive would be suitable as the nurse's assistant.
Despite being a full-grown man, Stan still has to try and smuggle women into his room behind the backs of his disapproving Mum and sneaking Arthur, so he rents a room at Blakey's house.
Sharon and Tracey get a glimpse of a possible future when they see two elderly sisters in the supermarket. Dorien's court case comes to a conclusion.
Robin fails his catering examination, and it looks as if he'll be leaving London to become a part of 'Tripp's Extruding Tubings, Southampton Limited'.
Rigsby drums up support for his own candidate as the local elections get under way.
Gary and Phoebe look likely to change the course of history in wartime Liverpool, where Ron's grandfather is said to have been a hero.
Gary is getting ready for Yvonne's return from Korea, but an unexpected arrival at the Royal Oak could cause him even more trouble.
Terry goes undercover to find out why a mini-cab firm is suffering so much violence.
Terry is asked to get rid of some squatters, leading Arthur to dream of a future as a property developer.
Class 5C break up for the very last time and prepare to meet the outside world, they give Mr Hedges a little something to remember them by.
A surprise visitor in the form of attractive Emma turns up at Tracey's house. Tracey is welcoming, Dorien is shocked to the core, and Travis is over the moon.
Gerry Kelly conducts interviews with guests from various walks of life.
Team 'That's TV' present a round-up of the local news for Greater Belfast, Northern Ireland.

Cocktail waiter Jason Gallagher turns up at the Solana looking for bar work, Mateo jealously tells him there are no jobs available, but when he skives off, Jason hops over the bar and attracts a crowd with his spectacular cocktail making.
Rigsby is given some advice from Alan and Philip, as well as some tablets to calm his nerves in his amorous pursuit of Miss Jones.
A tough new tenant plays his stereo very loud and Rigsby is afraid to ask him to keep it down.

Der Tod einer professionellen Rollschuhläuferin wirkt zunächst wie ein Unfall. Bei seinen Ermittlungen stößt Murdoch auf Rivalitäten im Wettkampf und er findet sich alsbald in einer Welt von gnadenlos ehrgeizigen jungen Frauen wieder.

Es geht drunter und drüber bei Astwell Chemicals. Zunächst versucht jemand, die Unterlagen für ein widerstandsfähiges Gummi zu stehlen, das die Firma in Deutschland produzieren lassen möchte. Kurz darauf wird Sir Reuben Astwell ermordet aufgefunden.

Eine thailändische Fußballmannschaft unternimmt eine Exkursion in die Tham-Luang-Höhle, um so den Zusammenhalt zu festigen. Doch aufgrund starker Regenfälle wird das Team in der Höhle eingeschlossen und der Ausflug entwickelt sich zu einem 17-tägigen Albtraum. Es beginnt ein Wettlauf gegen die Zeit und um das Überleben der zwölf Jungen und ihrem Trainer. Drei erfahrene Taucher setzen ihr Leben aufs Spiel, um einen Weg durch das Höhlenlabyrinth zu finden und die Mannschaft zu retten.

Die Themen sind "Blumenbeet stoppt Busse in Köln", "Elektrogesetz trifft Gartenbau in Ammerland", "Nutzlose Solaranlage in Mainz", "Absurder Wintergarten-Streit in Krefeld", "DHL findet Laden nicht in Bielefeld", "Hausabriss wegen Dachsanierung in Bornheim", "Zu tiefe Eisenbahnbrücke in Bottrop" und "Mädchen weiter ausgeschlossen beim Kinderschützenfest".

Die Themen sind "Putin, Klimakrise und andere Adventskatastrophen", "Generation Z: Jung, wütend, abgemeldet", "Merz, Söder, Klingbeil: Koalition der Trickser", "Deutsche Bank: Skandale mit Tradition" und "Inklusion: Weniger Geld für Schulen".

Paulines Gefühlsausbruch stößt auf Befremden bei Leonard - denn sie kann ihm seine Frage, ob sie wieder mit ihm zusammen sein will, nicht eindeutig beantworten. Pauline erkennt beschämt, dass ihre spontane Bitte, Leonard möge bleiben, angesichts der verfahrenen Situation zwischen ihnen nicht zu erfüllen ist. Vom Liebeskummer geplagt trifft sie auf André, der ihr einen entscheidenden Rat gibt. Natascha ist niedergeschlagen von Barbaras schockierenden Erzählungen und lässt sich von André trösten.

Pauline hat mit ihrem Fahrrad eine Reifenpanne. Doch ein charmanter Unbekannter - Leonards alter Freund Daniel - kommt ihr zu Hilfe und bringt Pauline mit frechem Witz und Charme zum Lächeln. Barbara ist von einem Erlebnis mit der komatösen Patrizia tief berührt und demonstriert vor André, dass sie ihren alten Kampfgeist wiederentdeckt hat: Ihrer Schwester zuliebe wird sie versuchen, so lange wie möglich am Leben zu bleiben.

Barbara entlässt sich selbst aus dem Krankenhaus und hört mit an, wie Friedrich über sie herzieht. Sie droht ihm, ihr Wissen um seine Vaterschaft von Patrizias Zwillingen preiszugeben. Michael wiederum hat herausgefunden, dass es einen Durchbruch bei der Therapie für Barbaras seltene Krankheit gibt. Er appelliert an sie, sich der bisher an Menschen nicht erprobten Therapie zu unterziehen. Aus Angst vor dem Tod willigt Barbara ein.

Der liebesblinde André legt sich weiter ins Zeug, um Natascha für sich zu gewinnen. Michael jedoch verdächtigt Natascha weiterhin, André ihre Gefühle nur vorzugaukeln. Nachdem André sich weiterhin resistent gegen Michaels Ratschläge erweist, appelliert dieser an Natascha, auf ihre Rache an André zu verzichten - jedoch vergeblich.

Der arrogante Schönheitschirurg Dr. Schubert wird in seiner Praxis von dem Proleten Mike Boll attackiert. Der vorbestrafte Boll ist wütend, weil seine Freundin Doreen über Schmerzen klagt, seit Schubert ihr ein Gesäß-Implantat eingesetzt hat.

Die Frau des Teestubenbesitzers Ismail Yildiz wird von dem Gemüsehändler Ömer Dilek entführt. Das behauptet zumindest eine Augenzeugin. Oder hat sie sich getäuscht? Die Familienmitglieder beider Parteien wollen nicht an ein Verbrechen glauben.

Erika lässt sich unwillig auf den therapeutischen Segelflugkurs ein. Sie hofft, dadurch Merle und Inge endgültig überzeugen zu können, dass sie nicht posttraumatisiert ist. Als in der Gärtnerei plötzlich aus einer exotischen Pflanze eine Bananenspinne kriecht, ist Inge entsetzt. Die sind hochgiftig! Erika unterschätzt die tödliche Gefahr und schreibt Inges Hysterie ihrer Spinnenphobie zu. Doch dann wird Erika von der Spinne gebissen.

Thomas wird auf Simones Hintertreiben in der Presse angefeindet. Volker rät ihm, Simones Streitereien zu ignorieren. Als das Bauamt erst nach Verzögerung die Unterlagen schickt, scheint das Projekt nun deutlich günstiger realisierbar zu sein als unter seinem Vorgänger. Thomas ahnt nicht, dass er direkt in Simones Falle tappt. Währenddessen können Merle und Inge aufatmen, denn Erika schwebt nicht in Lebensgefahr.

Fabian Silber, ein ebenso charismatischer wie schwergewichtiger Partnervermittler, wird nach einem Kollaps auf einem Flirt-Seminar in die Sachsenklinik eingeliefert. Beim Sturz hat er sich einen komplizierten Unterarmbruch zugezogen. Roland Heilmann will mit dem nötigen Eingriff warten, bis die Ursache für Fabians Herzbeschwerden klar ist. Nach Aussage von Fabians auffallend hübscher Frau Gesine war er immer kerngesund.

Fred Vogel, der mit seiner Frau Bärbel einen Käseladen betreibt, verletzt sich an der Käsemaschine. Roland Heilmann behandelt die Schnittwunde ambulant. Am nächsten Tag wird Vogel wegen heftiger Schmerzen erneut eingeliefert. Er klagt, durch die Ärzte der Sachsenklinik nicht richtig ernst genommen zu werden. Der Jäger Jan Frenzel wird am frühen Morgen im Berliner Stadtwald durch den Bolzen einer Armbrust tödlich getroffen. Frank Stolze, der Vorsitzende des Jagdverbandes, vermutet, dass der Anschlag auf das Konto militanter Tierschützer geht.

Thomas ahnt nicht, dass Simone ihm bei der Kostenplanung des Salzmuseums mit versteckten Kosten für eine Tiefgarage ein Bein stellt. Als jedoch aus einem Dinner for friends ein Treffen zu zweit wird, geben die beiden endlich ihrer Leidenschaft nach. Felix ist zunächst verunsichert von Rosalies Wunsch, zusammenzuziehen, worüber sich Rosalie bei Emma beschwert. In der Nacht träumt Emma von einem sehr zärtlichen Felix. André gesteht vor Gericht. Werners Zweifel schwinden. Marie ist eifersüchtig.

Rasch merkt Emma, dass die Idee einer Heirat nur der Wunsch von Rosalie allein ist. Felix will die Wohnung von Werners verstorbenen Schwiegereltern umbauen lassen. Rosalie sucht Glück im Spiel. Alfons will Marie helfen. Evelyn offenbart sich André.

Doch er kommt mit der Aussicht auf schnellen Ruhm nicht zurecht. Eine Affäre mit der Journalistin Annik beschleunigt das Ende seiner Ehe und verstärkt seine Schuldgefühle.

Drei Frauen landen gleichzeitig im selben Gefängnis. Während Orla darum kämpft, ihre Kinder nicht zu verlieren, wird die heroinabhängige Kelsey vor eine Entscheidung gestellt, und die knallharte Abi wird von einem düsteren Geheimnis verfolgt.

Sechs Monate später findet sich Orla in Carlingford wieder - doch sie will unbedingt den Kontakt zu ihren Kindern aufrechterhalten. Derweil nimmt Abis Racheplan eine unerwartete Wendung, und Kelsey denkt an ihre Zukunft.

Orla greift zu drastischen Maßnahmen, um Kyle sehen zu können, und Kelsey schmiedet Zukunftspläne. Abi hält weiterhin Abstand zu anderen Insassinnen - doch als sich eine Tragödie anbahnt, überwindet sie ihre Grenzen und verhindert Schlimmeres.

Orla versucht sich nach ihrer Entlassung mit Kyle zu versöhnen. Ermutigt von Marie-Louise und Kelsey stellt sich Abi ihrer tiefen Trauer in der Gruppentherapie. Kelseys Pläne geraten nach einer übereilten Entscheidung ins Wanken.

At the end of a bloody civil war, Francisco Franco seized power and ruled Spain with an iron hand for nearly four decades. Under his leadership the conservative, monarchist armed forces staged a coup against Spain's republican government which had been democratically elected. The insurrection was supported by Italy and Germany. Three years of bitter civil war followed which, by April 1939, had turned Spain into a different country. The hostilities and political purges cost half a million lives.

Jill Halliburton is murdered and police arrest a black man nicknamed Moochie. However, the testimony of the victim's son raises questions. Distressing scenes.

Following a team of experts as they investigate whether evidence exists that could challenge the conviction of a man in prison for a murder he denies. Inside Justice is a specialist charity led by Louise Shorter, supported by a panel of criminal lawyers, ex-police officers and forensics experts who offer assistance to prisoners who are protesting their innocence.

Louise investigates a case, looking for evidence that could present grounds to bring an appeal, and ultimately overturn the conviction of a Southampton man in prison for the murder of his secret lover.

Kenneth Kunz finds four of his family members murdered and one missing. Investigators must determine whether it was his mother, a local farm boy, or the rumoured family drug dealing connections that led to the brutal slayings.

The chief of police leads an investigation into what happened to his family friend and babysitter, who is reported missing when she doesn't come home from Christmas shopping, and is found beneath a snow bank weeks later.
A young police officer discovers the dark secret hidden in a neighbourhood restaurant.

When Erin Chorney disappears, suspicion falls on her ex-boyfriend Michael Bridges, the last person to have seen her. After investigators' searches come up empty-handed, they orchestrate an operation to woo Bridges into confessing her whereabouts.

On the outskirts of Nashville, Mich., Rodney Fancher's bullet-ridden body is found in a ditch. The hunt for a killer begins, pulling in police forces from across the state. As the case starts to turn cold, a startling confession emerges.

This feature-length film examines Aileen's harrowing life, tracing her story from the freezing woods of Michigan to the steamy swamps of Florida, and features her closest friends, her lawyers and even her estranged birth mother. At the heart of the film are the astonishing, unique, troubled interviews Broomfield filmed with Wuornos in prison, including her last, defiant words before execution.
The initial settlers of this island, confronted with lava-riddled rocks and iguanas that bear a striking resemblance to dinosaur descendants, dub it the "Island of the Damned".
Everyone hates biting insects, but if people were to look a little closer, they would be able to see that even the tiniest and most irritating bug can be essential for a working ecosystem.

After seeing a wolf in the distance and tracks on the shore, the crew head inland in search of more clues to the wolf's whereabouts. They encounter a familiar bear family on their way and decide to follow them to a local fishing spot.

From record-breaking mountain ranges to massive rainforests, the variety of landscapes supports a seemingly endless diversity of wildlife.
Winter is by far the longest season of Yellowstone as well as its cruellest. Only the toughest and cleverest survive the cold, starvation and competition.

Winter slowly releases its cold grasp on Yellowstone, but spring is slow to arrive. The sun melts the snow and ice, waking the park and its residents from a deep winter slumber. With the thaw comes water, and with water comes an abundance of food.

The warmth of spring brings new life and energy to Yellowstone. Bears come out of hiding. Babies of all shapes and sizes explore their incredible new world. Every resident is eager to enjoy this magical time full of promise.
Follows two families of river otters in Yellowstone and how they join together to face challenges.
An expedition across Bolivia in search of the most venomous snakes in the remote country.
The alpha female of the Hayden Valley Pack is followed in her life as a puppy until her death.

Go on an expedition beyond the bars of 12 of Western Germany's most popular zoos, get up close to some of the most intriguing animals on the planet, and witness their undisturbed behaviours and fascinating social interactions.
Many exotic animals that are threatened in the distant wilderness find a refuge in zoos in Europe.

In this first part we look at the state of nature in Central Europe. From the peaks of the Alps to the marshes, from the farmlands to the coasts. Unique images provide insight into this familiar, yet often still unknown habitat.

We see meadows, moors and coasts from their most beautiful side and get to know the animals that live there. But we are also confronted with the problems that exist and the state of our environment. Nitrogen is an ever-increasing danger.

The Alblasserwaard is the habitat of black-tailed godwits, purple herons, hares, barnacle geese, roe deer, moor frogs, marsh harriers and argus butterflies. The animals are followed at defining moments in their lives.
A look at how nature took over one of Europe's largest abandoned industrial zones in Germany's Ruhr area after 150 years.
Showcasing how the world's fastest predators can strike and kill in the blink of an eye, using modern high-speed cameras to capture these lightning-fast attacks in deadly detail.
In the battle between predator and prey, camouflage and speed often make the difference between life and death, as some of the fastest animals can strike and kill in the blink of an eye.

Lake Como is distinguished by its fauna and flora. The Pian di Spagna Nature Reserve is a haven for migratory birds, and Giardino della Valle di Cernobbio, an ancient landfill transformed into a garden, reveals its natural treasures.
Lake Garda is home to countless water birds, Mediterranean plants, and exotic insects, which coexist near the remains of ancient civilisations.
Between Lake Como and Lake Garda lies the smaller Lake Iseo. Less well known than its big brothers, it is considerably quieter. People here live on fish, olives, and even saffron.

The Tasmanian tiger was once thought to be long extinct, but recent evidence invokes a special team to track it down. A large den and footprints generate excitement.
Helen moved into a converted Methodist chapel, but it was soon clear she wasn't the only resident. During investigation, Barri gets hypnotised to find answers.

Drew Pritchard dives in at the huge former Naval Royal Hospital School in Suffolk. He's taught a couple of lessons whilst trying to negotiate a deal.

Bianca Stratford ist das beliebteste Mädchen an der Schule und jeder hätte gern ein Date mit ihr. Doch ihr Vater erlaubt ihr nur auszugehen, wenn ihre ältere Schwester Kat auch ein Date hat und mitkommt. Ihre Schwester ist allerdings weniger attraktiv. Um das Herz von Bianca zu erobern, engagiert der Schönling Joey den ebenfalls rebellischen Patrick, der gegen Bezahlung mit Kat ausgehen soll. Auch Cameron ist in Bianca verliebt und hofft auf eine Verabredung mit ihr.

Am Vorabend ihrer Hochzeit bekommt eine Braut Besuch von der Familie des Bräutigams. Die exzentrische Familie möchte sie in eine alte Tradition einweihen. Es dauert nicht lange, bis die Braut feststellt, dass es sich um ein tödliches Spiel handelt. Sie zieht die falsche Karte und muss sich bis zum Morgengrauen verstecken. Die Verwandtschaft ist ihr derweil mit Pistolen, Armbrüsten und anderen Waffen auf den Fersen.

Craig und Belinda streiten sich um ihr Vorstadthaus mit vier Schlafzimmern. Nachdem sie viele Jahre lang mit der Army umhergezogen ist, möchte Belinda an einem Ort bleiben, während Craig sich einen neuen Lebensstil wünscht.
Jenn entwirft eine schöne Küche, in der schon bald eine Party gefeiert werden soll.

Ein Paar, das vor kurzem ein Haus gekauft hat, benötigt Unterstützung bei der Umgestaltung in ein Zuhause für sich und seine drei Kinder. Christina plant eine Erweiterung ihres Hauptwohnraums, aber Probleme könnten die Renovierung verzögern.

Ein gesundheitlicher Rückschlag hat Ray und Kelley dazu inspiriert, auch häuslich einen Neuanfang zu wagen. Von Christina wünschen sie sich Hilfe bei der Vergrößerung ihrer Küche, die im aktuellen Zustand aus allen Nähten platzt.

Ein Ehepaar kämpft seit 15 Jahren mit der Renovierung ihres Hauses, was zu einer Reihe von eklektischen Räumen ohne Fluss geführt hat. Christina verleiht ihrem 100 Jahre alten Haus mit Farbe und Textur ein küstenländisches Flair.

Eigentlich steht die attraktive Professorin Charlie auf Paläontologen. Umso verwunderter ist Ross, als er erfährt, dass sie sich ausgerechnet mit Joey verabredet hat. Obwohl er selbst gerne ein Rendezvous mit Charlie gehabt hätte, hilft Ross seinem Freund, intelligent zu wirken. In der Zwischenzeit stellen Chandler und Monica erschrocken fest, dass ihr sowieso schon unangenehmer Besuch in der Fruchtbarkeitsklinik sogar noch schrecklicher wird als gedacht.

Chandler bringt seinen Kollegen Zack mit nach Hause, um ihn Monica als Samenspender vorzustellen - doch Monica will nur von Chandler schwanger werden. Da dies nicht möglich ist, entscheiden sie sich für eine Adoption. Indessen belauscht Charlie ein Gespräch zwischen Phoebe und Rachel, in dem es darum geht, dass Rachel es auf Joey abgesehen hat. Phoebe rät ihr, Charlie nicht in die Quere zu kommen.

All die investierte Mühe scheint vergeblich, als Ross durch einen Computerabsturz seine penibel erarbeitete Rede verliert, für die er extra nach Barbados gereist ist. Während er mit Charlie an einem neuen Vortrag arbeitet, keimen bislang ungekannte Gefühle in ihm auf. Auch Rachel hat mit unerwartetem Liebeskummer zu kämpfen: Obwohl sie sich krampfhaft zurückhält, hängt ihr Herz immer noch an Joey.

Während der rechtlichen Auseinandersetzung mit der Fluglinie müssen sich die Absturzüberlebenden den Gegebenheiten ihrer Verletzungen stellen. Derweil wendet Bailey Tricks an, um Arizona dazu zu bringen, an einem Fall mitzuarbeiten.

Inmitten des bevorstehenden Gerichtsverfahrens versuchen Cristina und Owen herauszufinden, wo ihre Beziehung steht. Bailey streitet sich mit Ben über die Hochzeitspläne, und Callie bittet Jackson, ihr dabei zu helfen, Dereks Hand zu retten.

Rory verhilft Lane zu einer Verabredung mit ihrem Schwarm Todd. Heimlich trifft sie sich mit dem Jungen. Alles scheint gut zu gehen. Nach einem Kinobesuch wird Lane jedoch von ihrer Mutter erwischt und mit Hausarrest bestraft. Lorelai lässt sich zu einem Doppeldate mit Sookie, dem Gemüsehändler Jackson und dessen langweiligen Cousin überreden. Luke ist so eifersüchtig, dass er sich endlich ein Herz fasst und Lorelai bittet, mit ihm auszugehen.

Auf einem Wohltätigkeitsbasar kauft Lorelai eine alte Jacke. Doch als sie diese Luke vorführen will, gerät er in Rage, denn die Jacke gehörte einst seiner großen Liebe Rachel. Lorelai versucht sogleich, mehr über die mysteriöse Ex-Freundin herauszufinden. Sookie hat indes Karten für ein Konzert der Bangles besorgt. Kurzerhand schenkt Lorelai Rory die Karten, damit diese ihre Mitschülerinnen aus Chilton einladen kann, um sich mit ihnen anzufreunden.

Lorelai überredet Luke, sein Lokal zu renovieren. Inzwischen lädt Rory Dean zu einem Abendessen ein, das unter dem Motto der 50er Jahre Serie "The Donna Read Show" steht. In dem Trubel geht Rory ein Küken, welches sie für ein Schulprojekt versorgen soll, verloren. Sogleich wendet sich Lorelai Hilfe suchend an Luke. Lorelais Reaktion bestätigt Emilys und Sookies Vermutung, dass sie mehr für Luke empfindet, als sie sich selbst eingesteht.

Die Ankunft von Rorys Vater Christopher sorgt für allerlei Turbulenzen. Bei einem Familienessen kommt es zu einem großen Streit zwischen Richard und Christophers Vater, der Lorelai vorwirft, das Leben seines Sohnes zerstört zu haben. Trotzdem landen Lorelai und Christopher anschließend zusammen im Bett, woraufhin er ihr überraschend einen Heiratsantrag macht.

Die Assistenzärzte haben eine Menge zu tun. Während Josephine mit Alex zusammenarbeitet, verliert Jo komplett die Nerven, als eine Mutter ihr krankes Kind im Stich lässt. Sie wird an ihre eigene Vergangenheit erinnert und alte Wunden reißen auf.

Die Hochzeit von Bailey und Ben steht an. Bailey wird nervöser und hat Angst, dass in ihrer Abwesenheit alles drunter und drüber geht im Seattle Grace. Christina und Owen müssen es einsehen: Ihre Ehe ist am Ende, eine Scheidung nicht vermeidbar.

Während Bree verzweifelt versucht herauszufinden, wer der Verfasser des ominösen Briefes ist, sucht Susan nach jeder möglichen Form der Bestrafung, um mit ihren Schuldgefühlen zurechtzukommen. Derweil setzt Gaby alle Hebel in Bewegung, damit sich Carlos besser fühlt und Lynette und Tom geraten wegen ihres Sohnes Parker aneinander.

Während Bree und Gaby versuchen herauszufinden, ob Chuck irgendetwas von ihrem Geheimnis ahnt, wendet sich Lee an Renee, da dieser ein Problem mit seiner Adoptivtochter Jenny hat. Derweil wird Mikes Misstrauen geweckt, als er sieht, wie Susan und Carlos ungewohnt viel Zeit miteinander verbringen und Lynette erhält Besuch von ihrer Schwester Lydia, die ihren neuen Verlobten mitbringt.

Lynette hat den Verdacht, dass sich Tom bereits mit einer neuen Frau trifft, während Bree Besuch von Tochter Danielle erhält und sehr überrascht ist, als sie die Wahrheit über deren neue Geschäftsidee herausfindet. Susan hingegen sucht nach Ablenkung und möchte einen Kunstkurs bei dem berühmten Künstler André Zeller absolvieren und Gaby legt sich mit Dana an, der Elternsprecherin an Juanitas Schule.

Susan ist entsetzt als ihr Kunstkurslehrer von den Teilnehmern verlangt, nackt aufzukreuzen. Bree kocht derweil für die Obdachlosen in einer Suppenküche ihre berühmte Suppe, was jedoch unerwünschte Entwicklungen mit sich bringt.

Ein totes Popsternchen in einer Gasse sorgt für enormes Aufsehen. Bei den Ermittlungen im wilden Partyleben machen Castle und Beckett eine Entdeckung, denn das Opfer ist nur ein Double. Um den Star zu schützen, nimmt Castle sie in Obhut.

Die Assistentin der berüchtigten Herausgeberin einer Modezeitschrift wird tot aufgefunden. Castle und Beckett ermitteln in der schillernden Welt der Haute Couture. Gleichzeitig sind sie vollauf mit Hochzeitsvorbereitungen beschäftigt.

Der Mitinhaber eines Sportstudios, Chad Parkman, wird sterbend mit einer Stichwunde in seinem Hotelzimmer aufgefunden, nachdem der Sicherheitschef des Hotels Kämpfe gehört und die Tür aufgebrochen hat. Vom Mörder fehlt jedoch jede Spur! Er kann weder durchs Fenster noch durch die Tür entkommen sein. Da Parkman Mitglied der Visualize-Sekte des Sektenführers Bret Stiles war, ermittelt Patrick Jane zunächst in diese Richtung. Doch dann taucht ein weiterer Toter in einem Auto auf.

Die von Red John ermordete Kira Tinsley hat Patrick Jane kurz vor ihrem Tod anvertraut, dass Red John eine Tätowierung hat: Drei Punkte auf seiner Schulter. Patrick Jane will alle verbliebenen Red-John-Verdächtigen zu einem gemeinsamen Treffen überreden, bei dem er herausfinden will, wer die Tätowierung trägt. Das Treffen gelingt, doch als Patrick sie mit vorgehaltener Waffe zwingt, ihre Schultern zu entblößen, erlebt er eine Überraschung.

Detektiv Bell wird Opfer eines feigen Anschlages, als er eine Tasche auf dem Revier untersuchen will. Die Bombe wird genau in dem Moment gezündet, als er die Tasche öffnet. Die Ermittler gehen davon aus, dass der Täter alles genau beobachtet hat.

Die Polizei ist auf der Suche nach einem gestohlenen Huhn, allerdings finden sie bei der Suche eine männliche Leiche. Diese Leiche trägt statt des eigenen Kopfes einen Hühnerkopf und alles deutet auf einen Ritualmord hin.

On the 1983 federal election night, Labor wins by a landslide and Bob Hawke becomes the new prime minister. On Oxford Street, there is an eruption of celebration. This could mean a big step forward in the fight for equality.
Elena grows tired of Gino, while Lila rejects two potential suitors at a cost. A rare outing into the city turns violent.
As Bertha's ambition shakes New York society, Agnes plots her comeback, while Marian seeks independence and Peggy fights for acceptance from her future in-laws.
While on a high school camping trip, 16-year-old Penelope feels called to abandon her family and friends to explore a new life in the wild unknown.
Penelope makes it through her first night in the forest and spends a day acquiring new wilderness skills through exhausting trial and error.
Alan Cumming uncovers more secrets as he stops by the seaside resort of Brighton, where he travels from the toy museum to the beautiful Royal Pavilion, once home to King George IV.
In Bristol, Alan Cumming uncovers a grisly secret hidden away at the docks before his journey takes him deep underground in Clifton and to the first speakeasy established in the city.
Summer has arrived, bringing with it all the hustle and bustle of tourism. While Pat prepares for a full house, it is up to powerboat instructor Mike to enforce the laws of the sea.
The fishermen spend some quality time with their loved ones, and Logan has a big decision to make.
Bobby sets his eyes on buying an NFL franchise, while Lara launches her own business venture. Chuck makes a last ditch effort to nail a big case.
Under pressure to make progress and with his case stalling, Chuck develops a new strategy. Axe considers donating half his net worth to charity.
Hunt, Liddy and the Cubans attempt to break into the DNC offices at the Watergate to plant listening devices for the White House.

Reeling from the arrests at the Watergate, Hunt enlists Saint John's help to dispose of evidence. Liddy warns the Attorney General that the burglaries can be tied back to President and Dorothy must take control to protect her family and the Liddys.
Having realised the cause of all of her misfortunes, Patrizia is forced to face up to a life-changing decision.

Ballard, Gharty, Pembleton and Stivers struggle to solve the savage murders of two politically active priests. When damning evidence points to two Central American refugees, some of the detectives must face their own prejudices while battling the archdiocese and the INS.

As Pembleton and Stivers finally pinpoint the real killers of the two politically active priests, their case hangs on the word of a key witness whose answers reach further than they could ever have imagined.

Liddy shares his concerns about Hunt's stability with John Dean and Hunt's daughter leverages a secret notebook to convince her father to come clean in his Senate testimony. When the President resigns, lives are ruined.

A young Pam gives birth to Jason after a complicated pregnancy. Elias climbs the corporate ladder as Jason grows into a young boy, and during his fourth birthday party, Jason shows alarming symptoms that lead Pam to question her life.
Charlie finally confesses what happened in the woods to Sam. Whilst searching the old farmhouse for a photograph, Sam uncovers startling evidence linked to Zach Culpepper.
Steve Coogan and Rob Brydon's Greek island-hopping adventure continues as they sample more of the country's gastronomic delights.
Rob and Steve enjoy a rainy day at Delphi, some Michelin-starred seafood and a battle to see who can do the greatest impressions.

Reeling from a traumatic tour of duty in Afghanistan, Joey, a former special forces soldier, returns to London to face another kind of war: life on the streets as a damaged, homeless veteran. In an attempt to rehabilitate himself, Joey assumes another man's identity and seeks the aid of Sister Cristina, a young nun who works at an inner-city parish.
An FBI agent must contend with a swarm of deadly serpents that have been released on board an airliner to kill the witness he is escorting to trial.
A kung fu expert is assigned to penetrate an island fortress to destroy an opium and white slavery empire.

Perseus, the demigod son of Zeus, is recruited to join a battle for supremacy between the Gods and the Titans who spawned them and embarks on a treacherous quest into the underworld to rescue his father, overthrow the Titans and save mankind.

The evil mummy Imhotep returns to wreak havoc as he resumes his relentless search for power and immortality. To make matters worse, another ancient evil has been unleashed, even more dangerous than Imhotep. Only the heroic Rick O'Connell and his intrepid Egyptologist wife stand in the way of these twin terrors as they embark upon a desperate mission to save the world.

In a time before the pyramids, an evil king threatens to take over the world, so the leaders of the remaining tribes under threat call upon a desert warrior to help them defeat the wicked one and his brutal hordes. As the warrior battles against the evil around him, he is preparing for a final showdown that will decide if it is to be his destiny to become the great Scorpion King.

Beginning in ancient China, the ruthless Emperor Han will stop at nothing to gain control of the region. Many years on, in the 1940s, Han's tomb is discovered, and Rick O'Connell and his wife Evelyn get drawn into a plot to resurrect the emperor and restore him to power.

A widowed farmer, with a brave but brutal military past, decides not to join up when the British arrive in 1776. However, when his son enlists and is later captured by the enemy, the former soldier must abandon his new-found pacifist principles in order to rescue his oldest child, and forms a regiment of Carolina patriots, whose guerrilla tactics prove pivotal to the US war effort.
Framed for the murder of his billionaire boss, a vengeful man uncovers an international conspiracy as he battles a gang of thugs aboard a cargo ship.

In an attempt to avenge the violent death of his parents, Bruce Wayne fights to rid the city of crime and in particular, his nemesis the Joker. However, his defences come down when an attractive journalist tries to track down the truth behind sightings of a huge bat-like figure in the sky.

It is the first year of Germany's occupation of France. Allied officer Lt Aldo Raine assembles a team of Jewish soldiers to commit violent acts of retribution against the Nazis, including the taking of their scalps. He and his men join forces with Bridget von Hammersmark, a German actress and undercover agent, to bring down the leaders of the Third Reich. Their fates converge with theatre owner Shosanna Dreyfus, who seeks to avenge the Nazis' execution of her family.
